vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: boilerplates
Version: 1.0.5

The skill bundle is a skeletal utility for managing local boilerplate templates and logs. The shell scripts (scripts/boilerplates.sh and scripts/script.sh) perform basic file operations like logging, searching, and exporting data within a local directory (~/.local/share/boilerplates). There is no evidence of network activity, data exfiltration, obfuscation, or malicious prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent with its stated purpose: a local collection of boilerplate templates and simple command-line helpers that write data to a local data directory and do not request credentials or network access.

dimensions.detail: Name/description claim a template collection and that matches the included files and scripts. The scripts implement tooling for listing/adding/exporting local boilerplate entries; no unrelated services or credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to run simple CLI commands (help, run, info, status). The shipped scripts operate on local files only and do not read unrelated system files, environment secrets, or contact external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec; this is instruction-and-script-only. No downloads or archive extraction occur. Risk from install mechanism is low.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No required env vars are declared. The code honours an optional BOILERPLATES_DIR environment variable (reasonable). The default data location is under the user's XDG_DATA_HOME or $HOME/.local/share/boilerplates — this is proportionate but does write to the user home directory.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request elevated privileges. It writes its own data/log files into a per-user data directory only (no modifications to other skills or system-wide config).
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a simple, local boilerplate/template helper written in bash. It does not contact the network or request credentials, but it will create and modify files under your data directory (defaults to $XDG_DATA_HOME or ~/.local/share/boilerplates). If you plan to use it, review the two shipped scripts (scripts/boilerplates.sh and scripts/script.sh) to confirm the behavior, or set BOILERPLATES_DIR to a sandboxed location before running. If you want extra safety, run it in a contained environment (container or VM) or inspect/modify the scripts to suit your directory preferences.
